summary: How far a task has got, shown as a filled track, or that it is running when how far is not known.

value.description: How far the task has got, between min and max. Without it the progress is indeterminate.

min.description: The value at the start of the task.

max.description: The value when the task is done.

fill.note: As long as the value's share of the range. With no value it is a third of the track that moves along it, and rests at the start when motion is not allowed.

guidance.text: The author names the progress with aria-label or aria-labelledby, and may give aria-valuetext.
Mark the region the task is filling with aria-busy and aria-describedby naming the progress.

notYet: The fill of a value is painted when the element is defined, not before; the indeterminate run is painted before definition and moves once the root is ready.
